methodology: Pipeline simulation + live VM testing. Verifier.py loaded directly with mock copy_from_env for pipeline tests. Live VM do-nothing CONFIRMED score=0/False after fix (setup_task.sh disables WFS at task start; verifier requires maxFeatures in [1000,50000], not >= 5000 which matched default 1000000).

do_nothing_no_export.description: copy_from_env raises FileNotFoundError (agent did nothing, export never ran)

do_nothing_baseline.description: Export ran but all fields at initial state (wfs_enabled=false, layer_found=false)

partial_no_sql_view.description: WFS service enabled with title + max_features, SLD city_marker created with circle mark, but SQL view layer not published

full_success.description: All criteria met: WFS enabled with Natural Earth WFS title + 5000 maxFeatures + major_cities SQL view layer (Point type) + city_marker SLD with circle/red mark

notes: SQL view major_cities uses ne_populated_places table. Verifier searches all datastores in ne workspace for the layer. Tests: WFS service configuration, SQL view creation, PointSymbolizer SLD. IMPORTANT: setup_task.sh disables WFS at task start (GeoServer default is enabled). maxFeatures must be in [1000, 50000] — default value 1000000 does NOT score. Title must contain 'Natural Earth' for full 10pts; no partial credit for default title.
